task.goal: Open the file task.html in Downloads in the file manager; when prompted open it with Chrome. Then navigate the X to the bottom-right cell, by using the direction buttons.
task.final_summary: I opened task.html from Downloads and chose Chrome, then solved the maze puzzle. Using the direction buttons I moved the X from the top-left cell down, right three times, and down into the green bottom-right cell, and the page now shows "Success!".
